label: Pet Toon Image Only V1
description: raw pet episode narrative를 받아 GPT Image 2 reference-image workflow로 컷별 웹툰 이미지를 생성하고, 최종 결과를 episodes/<slug>/images/에 이미지 파일로만 남기는 pet-toon 포맷.

runnerHints.intakeStage: if the Paperclip issue title starts with [Pet Toon], treat the raw issue narrative as enough input to bootstrap an image-only episode packet
runnerHints.sourceStage: lock protagonist, episode truth, cut count, setting, safety notes, and reference assets before any image call
runnerHints.styleLockStage: if cast already exists under characters/<slug>, derive a strict reference-only style lock from their bibles and image refs; do not reinterpret, polish, or convert the art style
runnerHints.imageProviderRule: use the Paperclip central image generation API first so the server holds the OpenAI key and calls GPT Image 2; use the repo-local direct OpenAI runner only as a manual fallback
runnerHints.storyboardStage: write storyboard/storyboard-plan.json with per-cut prompts, exact cast cardinality, and reference image paths before generating cut images
runnerHints.identityLockStage: every cut must use the same character registry and the same reference pack; first appearance of any newly introduced character becomes the canonical lock for all later appearances
runnerHints.outputStage: save individual cut images under images/cuts/ and the stacked webtoon strip under images/episode-strip.png
runnerHints.stopStage: stop after image generation and manifest write; do not create keyframe plans, camera plans, scene videos, dubbing, SFX, typography, QA video packets, or publish packets

imageGenerationPolicy.characterConsistencyRule: copy the approved character drawing style almost exactly from canonical refs; preserve fur color, face marks, eye shape, nose, ear silhouette, outline roughness, color texture, proportions, and personality posture
imageGenerationPolicy.newCharacterRule: if an undefined person or character appears, create a stable slug, record their first generated design in character-continuity.json, and reuse that locked description and first image for every later cut
imageGenerationPolicy.castCardinalityRule: each cut must declare which characters are present and how many instances of each are allowed; default is exactly one instance of each named character
imageGenerationPolicy.mutationBlockers: forbid duplicate pets, second version of same character, extra animals, extra limbs, wings, merged faces, wrong fur color, wrong ear shape, changed eye style, photorealism, glossy 3D, unrelated manga/anime style, text, subtitles, logos, and watermarks

filePolicy.imageJobs: openai-image-jobs/*.json; agents submit these through /api/companies/:companyId/image-generations when Paperclip env is present

safetyPolicy.publicUseRule: do not publish generated images until the operator approves visual identity and rights status
